scenes.text: Most voice agents answer in textbook Hindi, or textbook English. That is not how you talk. Sangam is a voice agent that talks like you.
Say it the way you really say it. Sangam tags every word, Hindi or English, and measures how you mix them.
Then it replies. On the left, a typical agent: stiff English. On the right, Sangam: your own mix, with the gap measured.
Gnani Prisma listens. Gnani Timbre speaks the reply.
Measured, not claimed: ninety six point seven percent tagging accuracy on held out sentences.
Sangam. A voice agent that talks like you.
